scope: Independent read-only audit of preserved historical records; no CAD, no native resource-gate bypass, no new clearance run.
algorithm: Compare whole ZIP size and SHA with fixed acceptance records.
Independently stream every manifest member to EOF and verify actual SHA/size plus ZIP CRC.
Enumerate the complete unordered pair set from each unique 154-body roster, compare every recorded pair and selected/completed journal line.
Read current producer/reader raw projected records independently; compare all STEP/BREP identities, 154 body signatures and 11781 pair values.
Bind exact current R3/R4 whole materials and K1/K3 named sources; retain F1 failures and classify exact duplicate record identities.
Check every output scope flag and omitted runtime-field record; make no historical-runtime or continuous-G2 claim.
capacity_basis: At most one <=16MiB member plus parsed JSON at a time, 1MiB streaming buffers; two producer/reader current records retained only while compared. Each prior same-size audit completed in about 9s/<78MiB, but this separate implementation must record its own actual resources.
